# Siddhant Kadam
> Full-Stack & Platform Infrastructure Engineer

## About
Go/Node.js engineer specializing in distributed systems, GCP, Redis, MQTT, and IoT. Based in Maharashtra, India. 2 years of experience delivering measurable impact — 80% database cost reduction, 500ms API latency improvement, secure OTA infrastructure for IoT fleet.
